jobs.occupation: Key Account Manager Top 3 - Retail Sector
jobs.description:
Our client is a leading distributor. It has a strong presence across the Belgian market with a portfolio of well-known consumer brands in Retail and E-commerce. The organization focuses on innovation, sustainability, and improving everyday life through practical and high-quality products. Operating within a global network, it combines local market expertise with international resources. Its Belgian team plays a key role in driving commercial growth and strengthening relationships with major retail partners.

Jobomschrijving

The Key Account Manager - Top 3 - Retail will have the following responsibilities:

• Full management and oversight of a portfolio of key accounts
• Negotiation of customer agreements and commercial contracts
• Development of strategic plans for each client and preparation of sales forecasts
• Monitoring and analysis of customer performance, identifying opportunities for improvement and growth
• Ensuring the distribution of permanent product ranges and promotional activities
• Budget management and monitoring
• Close coordination with marketing teams to maximize product distribution across the brand portfolio within key accounts

• Minimum of 3 years of experience as a Key Account Manager
• Experience with Top 3 clients is a big plus 
• Good communication skills, analytical, team player
• Fluent in both Dutch and French, with good command of English

Our client is an international BtoB organization operating across multiple countries and known for delivering tailored solutions to corporate customers. In Belgium, the company employs over 100 professionals across two offices and provides a wide range of specialized services. 

To support this strategic ambition, they are looking for an AI Integration Analyst who will play a central role in identifying, implementing, and driving the adoption of AI-powered solutions throughout the organization.

Jobomschrijving

As AI Integration Analyst, you will act as the link between business teams, project management, IT stakeholders, and international AI communities.

Your mission will be to accelerate the practical adoption of AI by identifying high-value opportunities, supporting implementation projects, delivering training and workshops, and helping employees integrate AI tools into their day-to-day activities: AI Opportunity Identification & Business Engagement

• Facilitate workshops with business and IT stakeholders to identify AI use cases.
• Assess and prioritize opportunities according to business value, feasibility, and organizational impact.Translate business challenges into practical AI and automation solutions.
• Support departments in identifying productivity and efficiency gains through AI.

AI Implementation & Project Support

• Coordinate and follow up on AI implementation projects across different business functions.
• Work closely with project managers, data analysts, IT teams, and external partners.
• Monitor project progress, adoption levels, and business outcomes.
• Ensure AI initiatives are aligned with governance, compliance, and security requirements.

Training, Adoption & Change Management

• Develop and deliver AI training sessions, awareness programs, and workshops.
• Promote best practices for the use of AI technologies throughout the organization.
• Drive user adoption through communication, coaching, and continuous support.
• Contribute to the development of the organization's overall AI capabilities and maturity.

International Collaboration

• Collaborate with colleagues and AI specialists from international entities.
• Share knowledge, use cases, and implementation experiences.
• Support the rollout of international AI initiatives at a local level.
• Act as an ambassador for AI-driven transformation within the business.

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business, Technology, Data Analytics, Information Systems, or a related field.
• Proven experience in AI implementation, digital transformation, innovation, business analysis, project management, process improvement, or technology consulting.
• Strong understanding of Artificial Intelligence, Generative AI, and emerging AI technologies.
• Experience working within the Microsoft ecosystem (Microsoft 365, Copilot, Power Platform, Power Automate, Azure AI, or similar technologies).
• Understanding of APIs, system integrations, data flows, and enterprise technology environments.
• Experience supporting change management, training initiatives, and technology adoption.
• Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
• Ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences.
• Hands-on technical or programming experience is considered an asset but is not required.
• Good command of Dutch and excellent English communication skills. French would be an advantage but is not required.

Our client is a well-established and specialized company operating in the field of machinery and railway equipment. They are known for their dynamic SME environment and strong team collaboration.

Jobomschrijving

The Internal Sales Representative plays a key role in supporting the sales team by managing quotations, processing orders, and ensuring smooth communication between customers, suppliers, and internal departments.

Key Responsibilities

• Receive and handle price requests via email, phone, and other channels
• Request quotations from suppliers and negotiate pricing and conditions with the Sales Director

• Enter offers and orders into the ERP system (knowledge of Navision or Business Central is a strong asset)
• Follow up on ongoing quotations in collaboration with the sales team
• Monitor and manage ongoing orders (delivery timelines, framework agreements)
• Handle customer complaints and provide appropriate solutions
• Send payment reminders when required
• Collaborate closely with the administrative team
• Support the preparation of trade shows and exhibitions
• Assist in preparing orders and coordinating shipments
• Ensure electronic registration of warehouse entries and exits
• Participate in inventory counts when needed
• Provide occasional support in the warehouse (receiving and shipping goods)

Profile

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience
• Previous experience in a back-office or order processing role
• Strong knowledge of Microsoft Office
• Trilingual: Dutch / French and English or German
• Detail-oriented, stress-resistant, and versatile
• Reliable, consistent, and commercially minded

Nice to have:

• Knowledge of ISO 9001 and/or VCA standards

• Our client is a leading European consumer services organization operating across multiple international markets.
• Recognized for its customer-centric approach, the company continuously invests in service excellence, operational efficiency and process improvement.

Jobomschrijving

• Monitor and assess customer interactions and service quality performance to identify trends, gaps and opportunities for improvement.
• Design, coordinate and manage customer experience assessment programs, including quality audits and mystery shopping initiatives across multiple countries.
• Analyze customer feedback, operational performance metrics and quality data to support informed decision-making. 
• Map and evaluate customer journeys across channels, identifying friction points and recommending practical improvement actions.
• Collaborate with operational and regional stakeholders to support the implementation of service quality and customer experience initiatives.
• Prepare insightful reports, dashboards and presentations for leadership teams, translating data into clear business recommendations.

• 3-5 years of experience in Customer Experience, Service Quality, Operational Excellence, Business Analysis or a related field.
• Strong analytical mindset with the ability to interpret complex data, identify trends and transform insights into actionable recommendations.
• Advanced proficiency in Excel, Power BI and reporting tools.
• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively in a multicultural environment.
• Able to work autonomously in a cross-functional environment.
• Fluent in English and French or Dutch; additional European languages are considered an asset.
• Flexible to travel across Europe (approximately 20%).

The successful candidate will maintain positive relationships with clients, legal professionals, and internal stakeholders while ensuring the highest level of confidentiality at all times.

 

Client Details

Our client is a leading international law firm with a strong presence in Brussels. They are currently seeking an experienced Management Assistant to provide high-level administrative and organisational support to a team of lawyers within a fast-paced and demanding environment.

 

Description

As a Management Assistant, you will play a key role in ensuring the smooth day-to-day operation of the legal team by providing comprehensive administrative support.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Managing complex calendars and coordinating meetings.
• Organising domestic and international travel arrangements.
• Assisting with client onboarding and matter opening processes.
• Supporting billing and expense management activities.
• Drafting, proofreading, formatting and finalising legal documents and correspondence.
• Managing document filing and record-keeping systems.
• Handling incoming calls, emails, and correspondence professionally.
• Coordinating meeting rooms and related services, including catering and IT support.
• Liaising with internal departments and external stakeholders.
• Ensuring a high level of confidentiality and professionalism at all times.
• Providing general administrative support and assisting with ad hoc projects.

 

• Strong previous experience as a Management Assistant, ideally within an international law firm or professional services environment.
• Excellent organisational and multitasking skills.
• Strong attention to detail and ability to manage competing priorities.
• Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Office (Outlook, Word, PowerPoint).
• Experience with document management systems is an advantage.
• Fluent English, together with French and/or Dutch.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
• Professional, proactive and service-oriented mindset.
• Ability to handle confidential information with discretion.
• Flexible and adaptable approach in a fast-paced environment.

jobs.occupation: Warehouse worker - night shift - English allowed!
jobs.description:
Already living in Belgium and looking for a stable logistics job?

Are you a true night owl who performs best during the night? Do you already have some experience in warehouse work or logistics? And are you looking for a stable employer with a lot of job security? Then this could be the perfect job for you!

For a leading logistics company in Oostkamp, we are looking for motivated warehouse workers to join the team in the night shift. You will help distribute frozen food products to supermarkets across Belgium and Europe while working in a modern logistics environment where English is fully accepted.

Your role

As a warehouse operator, you are an important part of the logistics process. Using an electrical pallet truck (EPT), you help ensure that products are received, stored and shipped correctly.

Your responsibilities include:

• Loading and unloading trucks
• Performing quality checks on incoming and outgoing goods
• Keeping the warehouse organised and safe
After a while, you can also receive internal reach truck training and expand your responsibilities.

Be sure to apply if you:

• Have experience in warehouse work or logistics
• Can operate an electrical pallet truck (EPT) with ease
• Aren't afraid of working in cold environments
• Specifically want to work in night shift
• Have your own transportation to the company (no public transport nearby)
Reach truck experience is a big plus but not required.

!! If you don't meet every requirement but have some warehouse experience and a strong work ethic, you can still apply !!

 

IMPORTANT: this job is only available for people who:

• Already live in Belgium
• Have a valid Belgian address
• Have legal permission to work in Belgium
Housing, relocation and visa sponsorship are not available for this position.

As a Production Team Lead, you will be responsible for the daily production of personalized cell therapies for both clinical and commercial use in a sterile cGMP environment. You will coordinate the different units within the CAR-T process and ensure that all activities are carried out safely and in full compliance with cGMP requirements — while steering and organizing the operations from your office-based workspace, keeping a strong overview of the production flow and acting as the central point of coordination for the team.
 

If you don't have prior leadership experience yet, that is also okay. If you have solid GMP experience (ideally in production or close to production) and you naturally take ownership, coordinate smoothly, and feel comfortable guiding others, we strongly encourage you to apply.
 

Responsibilities:
 

 
• Coordinate and supervise operational units within the CAR-T manufacturing process, including component preparation, production support, CAR-T processing, filling & finishing, and cryopreservation.
 
• Act as the first point of contact for production issues and collaborate closely with Manufacturing Operations, QC IPC, Quality, Facilities & Engineering, MS&T/Manufacturing Excellence, Training, Planning, and Supply Chain.
 
• Serve as a domain expert for Quality and Operations in cGMP environments and play a key role during GMP inspections and external audits.
 
• Manage all quality-related production aspects, including procedures, work instructions, logbooks, transfer forms, batch record review and release, and overall cGMP compliance.
 
• Coordinate quality system activities such as Change Controls, Deviations/Events, and CAPA.
 
• Ensure proper training of team members and promote a culture of continuous learning.
 
• Drive operational excellence by initiating improvements that increase efficiency, reduce costs, and enhance overall quality. 

Who we are looking for: 
 

 
• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Science, Bio-Engineering, Pharmacy, or a related field, or equivalent through experience.
 
• Minimum 3 years of experience in a GMP environment, preferably in biotech or biopharma. 
 
• Experience in people management, or with relatable coordinating activities such as training, coaching, ... .
 
• Solid knowledge of cGMP regulations and cleanroom operations; familiarity with Microsoft Office is required, and experience with MES/EBR is a plus.
 
• Strong communication and organizational skills. You don’t need formal leadership experience, but you do show natural leadership qualities: 
 

 
• you take ownership
 
• you guide and support others confidently
 
• you keep oversight and work in a structured way 
 

 
• Positive, flexible, and capable of prioritizing, multitasking, and solving problems effectively, with strong attention to detail.
 
• Fluent in English; additional languages are a plus.

As a Production Supervisor, you are responsible for the daily production process of personalized cell therapy, both for clinical and commercial purposes. You will lead various units within the CAR-T process and ensure safe and compliant production activities in accordance with cGMP requirements — all while coordinating and overseeing operations from your dedicated office workspace, maintaining a clear overview of the production floor and ensuring smooth cross-team collaboration.
 

Tasks:
 

 
• Lead and supervise operational units within the CAR-T production process, including component preparation, production support, CAR-T processing, filling & finishing, and cryopreservation.
 
• Act as the primary point of contact for production-related topics, ensuring smooth coordination with Manufacturing Operations, QC IPC, Quality, Facilities & Engineering, MS&T/Manufacturing Excellence, Training, Planning, and Supply Chain.
 
• Provide hands-on leadership on the shop floor, supporting teams in daily operations, troubleshooting, and decision-making in cGMP environments.
 
• Serve as a subject matter expert for Quality and Operations and play a key role during GMP inspections and external audits.
 
• Oversee production quality activities, including documentation management (procedures, work instructions, logs, transfer forms), batch record review and release, and compliance with cGMP standards.
 
• Coordinate quality system processes such as Change Controls, Deviations/Events, and CAPA.
 
• Guide and support team development through structured training and operational coaching.
 
• Drive operational excellence by leading process improvements focused on efficiency, cost reduction, and quality enhancement. 

Who we are looking for: 
 

 
• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Science, Bio-Engineering, Pharmacy, or a related field, or equivalent through experience.
 
• Minimum 3 years of experience in a production environment, preferably in biotech or biopharma.
 
• Strong experience in management, for example as a production lead, supervisor, or similar leadership role.
 
• Solid knowledge of cGMP regulations, cleanroom operations, and familiarity with Microsoft Office; experience with MES/EBR systems is a plus.
 
• Strong communication, organizational, and leadership skills with an empathetic and people-oriented management style.
 
• Positive, flexible, and capable of prioritizing, multitasking, and solving problems effectively, with a strong attention to detail.
 
• Fluent in English (additional languages are a plus).
